overview: The Medford School Committee recognized student orchestra performance and fall athletes, honored departing committee members, reviewed an update on middle school HVAC renovations, and approved the recommended FY27 capital plan.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Music Performance and Fall Athletics Recognition
items.summary: The committee enjoyed a performance by the Medford High School Orchestra and recognized Fall GBL champions and All-Star student-athletes across multiple sports.

items.title: Special Recognition of Departing School Committee Members
items.summary: The committee honored outgoing members Nicole Branley and John Intoppa for their service and contributions to the school district.

items.title: McGlynn and Andrews HVAC and Roof Project Update
items.summary: Project managers reported that the electrification and HVAC upgrades at the McGlynn and Andrews schools are approximately 45 percent complete and tracking under budget, with full completion expected in spring 2026.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine items, including bills, payrolls, donations, grants, field trips, and past meeting minutes.

items.title: FY27 Capital Plan Approval (Resolution 2025-38)
items.summary: Approved the recommended $2 million FY27 prioritized capital request and authorized sending an accompanying memo to the mayor and City Council.

items.title: High School Building Committee Appointment (Resolution 2025-39)
items.summary: Accepted the resignation of Tracy Keene from the Medford Community High School Building Committee and appointed Paul Malone to fill the vacancy.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation Input Request (Resolution 2025-40)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting outgoing members Nicole Branley and John Intoppa submit their evaluation input for the interim superintendent by December 31, 2025.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Expressed condolences to the families of former Medford science teacher Francis R. Frank Cangiano and parent Julie McDonald-Matterese.
